# Feature Requirements Quality Checklist: 工业协议通信分析

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario coverage of the feature requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are supported EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP, OPC UA TCP, and MQTT traffic classes, including VLAN-tagged, unknown, truncated, encrypted, or partially decoded traffic, bounded clearly enough to define feature coverage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Assumption]
- [x] CHK002 - Are the meanings and evidence sources for traffic counts, business categories, and category shares specified consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 - Are permissions for viewing results, changing monitoring settings, retention, baselines, and MQTT targets consistently assigned to the existing switch roles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK004 - Are retention scope, default duration, configurable longer duration, and platform-supported maximum all defined without implying unbounded storage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK005 - Are report content, supported availability/export expectations, and the relationship between report time windows and available data sufficiently specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §SC-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Are RTT, jitter, response timeout, inferred packet loss, and checksum failure defined with distinct measurement bases and confidence limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004–FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 - Is “业务类别/服务类别” bounded by explicit protocol fields or a referenced category vocabulary, including unknown and unparseable cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 - Are the response-wait threshold’s scope, units, valid range, and effect on timeout classification clear enough to avoid conflicting interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 - Are the health, alert, confirmed-error, unknown, and incomplete-observation states defined consistently across overview, topology, events, and reports? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010–FR-011, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the meaning of PROFINET refresh period/rate and the minimum evidence needed to call it available clearly distinguished from “unavailable” or “insufficient data”? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Spec §SC-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 - Do passive capture requirements, topology discovery, product-reference features, and explicit exclusions consistently prohibit active scanning or traffic injection? [Consistency, Product Reference Review, Spec §FR-016, Assumption]
- [x] CHK012 - Are CPU mirror loss, network packet loss, parse failure, and unavailable checksum visibility consistently kept separate throughout requirements and edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Do requirements consistently prevent unknown, incomplete, stale, or time-unstable observations from being presented as healthy or confirmed normal? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK014 - Are MQTT transport encryption, broker authentication, credential protection, delivery-failure visibility, and local-event retention stated consistently across scenarios, requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Spec §SC-014]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Can every success criterion be assessed against a defined reference sample, observation window, or explicit user-visible outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-014]
- [x] CHK016 - Are platform-dependent performance and capacity claims tied to an explicit target-SKU qualification profile rather than an unbounded promise? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context, Tasks T001, T037]
- [x] CHK017 - Are the accuracy tolerances for RTT, traffic classification, event counts, jitter, and refresh-rate estimates precise enough to reproduce acceptance judgments? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–SC-004, Spec §SC-012–SC-013]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 - Are primary, no-traffic, one-way-only, partial-capture, malformed-frame, overload, and counter-reset scenarios covered with distinct outcomes? [Coverage, User Stories 1–4, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 - Are baseline rejection or degraded-confidence requirements explicit for incomplete capture, unstable time, or failed parsing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, User Story 5, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 - Are MQTT connection, TLS, authentication, broker-acknowledgment, and retry/failure outcomes sufficiently specified, including what remains locally available? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, Spec §SC-011, Spec §SC-014]
- [x] CHK021 - Are data lifecycle requirements defined for retention changes, device restart, clock changes, counter resets, and loss of observation continuity? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-023, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Dependencies

- [x] CHK022 - Are CPU/memory impact, supported mirror throughput, timestamp precision, update interval, and overload behavior expressed as measurable per-SKU requirements or explicit qualification outputs? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context, Tasks T001, T037]
- [x] CHK023 - Are the switch ACL/mirroring, timebase, port counters, TLS client, secure credential storage, and existing account-system dependencies identified with unavailable-capability behavior? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-022–FR-023, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK024 - Are security and privacy boundaries for raw OT payloads, stored aggregates/events, MQTT alert evidence, and credential material explicit and mutually consistent? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-022, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK025 - Are TCP sequence-gap, retransmission, timeout, bounded reassembly, capture-coverage confidence, and flow-capacity loss requirements clear for partially mirrored or asymmetric flows? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026–FR-031]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy review
